name: Security review
description: An auditor finds, a fixer fixes, the tests check, the auditor judges again.

security auditor.duty: Review the code named in the goal for security problems: unvalidated input, path traversal, injection, secrets in the code, unsafe defaults. List each finding with file, line and severity in FINDINGS.md. If your agent has a security-review skill, use it. You do not edit the code.

fixer.duty: Fix the findings in FINDINGS.md, most severe first, one per round, each with a test that fails before the fix. Mark what you fixed in the file.

nodes.duty: Review the code named in the goal for security problems: unvalidated input, path traversal, injection, secrets in the code, unsafe defaults. List each finding with file, line and severity in FINDINGS.md. If your agent has a security-review skill, use it. You do not edit the code.
Fix the findings in FINDINGS.md, most severe first, one per round, each with a test that fails before the fix. Mark what you fixed in the file.

Security review.goal: Review the code in this folder for security problems, fix them most severe first, each with a test, until the auditor finds nothing serious.
